description: What new construction costs, from U.S. government series only. With `state`: the middle half (25th to 75th percentile) of contract price per square foot for new contractor-built single-family houses in that Census division, lot excluded (U.S. Census Bureau, Survey of Construction). With `sqFt` too: that band times the size, as a range. Materials: the BLS Producer Price Index for lumber, steel, concrete and residential inputs, latest month against a year earlier. Every row has its source, year and record. Ranges, never one number.

item.description: Narrow the answer, e.g. "lumber", "materials" or "build cost".

sqFt.description: House size in square feet (200 to 50,000), for a total build range.

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code, e.g. "TX". Picks the Census division band.

name: cost_ranges
title: Construction cost ranges from U.S. government data
